content.short: Solana Explorer is a Solana blockchain explorer for viewing transactions, blocks, programs, tokens and accounts across Solana clusters.
content.description: The Solana Explorer is a Solana blockchain explorer that lets you inspect activity across Solana clusters. Users can view transactions, blocks, programs, tokens, and accounts, providing a comprehensive view of on-chain activity and relationships. Developers can access the devnet cluster to enable developer settings, explore test dapps on the testnet, or connect to a custom RPC URL for their own networks. This tool supports cross-cluster visibility and quick access to essential on-chain data.
